description: This file provides utility functions for creating and opening GitHub issue URLs with proper encoding to bypass VS Code's URI handling issues. It includes functions to generate encoded URLs, open URLs via platform-specific commands, and a high-level function to create and open GitHub issues with pre-filled fields.

methods.name: createGitHubIssueUrl
methods.description: Constructs a properly encoded GitHub issue URL with query parameters encoded using encodeURIComponent.

methods.name: openUrlInBrowser
methods.description: Opens a URL using platform-specific commands to avoid VS Code's URI handling issues, with fallbacks including copying to clipboard and using vscode.env.openExternal.

methods.name: createAndOpenGitHubIssue
methods.description: High-level function that creates a GitHub issue URL with parameters and opens it, working around VS Code's URI handling limitations.
